notes: Aggregates current tax.us.2025.f1099div.box1b-qualified findings into the box-1b source subtotal under the asserted rounding convention (ADR-0035 decisions 1-2). The source_set names the adopted source-family declaration tax.us.2025.f1099div.1b, which closes independently of box 1a; an empty family publishes zero only through a current literal-true closure finding admitted by the adopted mapping, and otherwise blocks. This symbol is the box-1b subtotal only - it never publishes to, or stands behind, Form 1040 line 3a directly. The per-statement 1b <= 1a invariant is enforced at admission (ADR-0035 decision 4, packages/kernel/findings.py), never re-derived here; this rule only sums whatever box-1b findings are current.
